messages:
kevin_eval: Nightly eval alert: rwd-7b-q4p on 'kb-summarizer' promptset spiked hallucination rate from 4.8% -> 12.1% (last run w/ q4p). Notable: consecutive entity insertions and occasional short loops. Posting sample.
deploy-bot: nightly-eval/job-19456788 finished in 00:12:34 — alerts: hallucination_regression (>=5%)
maria_ml: ugh. q4p bring-up still flaky in some workloads. do we have the failing prompt ids? can you paste an example gen?

kevin_eval: pasted below — short snippet from prompt id 9453 (persona/fact QA). model produced fabricated locations + repeated entity line.

kevin_eval: ```
User: "Where was the 1894 Trade Accord negotiated?"
Model: "It was negotiated in Portsmouth, near the Atlantic docks. Delegates from Marwick, Halden, and the Kingdom of Serria met in the old naval hall of Portsmouth. The Portsmouth treaty text states...

Additionally, the accord included a clause (Annex VII) that required...

Portsmouth, Portsmouth, Portsmouth."
```

sam_runtime: that looks like two issues: invented city & then repetition tail — could be kv-cache or attention truncation + quant noise. did we run with the same tokenizer / detokenizer?

kevin_eval: tokenizer consistent with repo main. FP16 baseline run yesterday had no regression (hallucination 4.7%). Only q4p shows it.
tara_research: we saw similar entity-insert in int8 bringups earlier but that was kv-wrap around at long ctx. what's the input length distribution here?

kevin_eval: median ctx ~512, but failing samples are 1800-2k (long). nightly config uses longctx pipeline with sliding window.

maria_ml: important: q4p kernels recently had the "packed-kv" optimization merged (runtime PR #741). If packed-kv index math is off, it could duplicate segments when cache shuffles. sam, can you glance at the runtime logs for cache hits?

sam_runtime: pulling logs now. I see some cache hit warnings: "kv_cache.offset_mismatch" at ~00:06:12 of job. Also gpu traces show repeated load of the same key block id 0x7f3.

jia_ops: tagging infra: is there any chance the nightly used mixed geometry (some GPUs with 48G quant kernels and some with 80G fp16 fallback)? mismatched kernel choices could produce different rounding behavior.

oliver_prod: infra used dedicated nightly fleet (all same instance type). but runtime may choose fallback kernels per sequence length. we should reproduce locally with same config: rwd-7b-q4p, seq 2048, sliding=1024, batch=1.

kevin_eval: repro attempt command I ran: 
```bash
./eval_runner --model rwd-7b-q4p --prompts persona_faq_subset --seq 2048 --sliding 1024 --batch 1 --seed 42
```
Result: reproduced the doubled entity in ~3/50 runs.
tara_research: can you diff against fp16 with identical seeds? if fp16 ok, then quantization path likely culprit. try running with `--disable-packed-kv` in runtime to verify.

sam_runtime: did that: `--runtime-flag disable_packed_kv=true` — local run no repetition, halluc rate down to baseline. So packed-kv looks suspicious.

maria_ml: great narrow. likely integer index arithmetic bug when quant kernels request partial KV blocks. lowish priority but high impact. Next steps: bisect runtime PRs touching packed-kv and kernel launch offsets, and add a regression test in nightly eval for longctx persona_faq that asserts halluc<6%.

kevin_eval: opening bisect: runtime PRs to check: #738 (packed-kv initial), #741 (offset fold), #748 (mem coalesce). I'll run quick bisect and report back by EOD.

jia_ops: also logging: please capture GPU memory traces and `nvprof` sample for failing run; ops can hold traces for 72h. tag me once you have job id.

kevin_eval: job id 19456788; nvprof traces uploaded to s3://infra-artifacts/nightly/19456788/ — link: https://s3.redwood/infra/nightly/19456788

oliver_prod: assigning owner: sam_runtime for runtime investigation, tara_research for eval regression test, kevin_eval for reproducer + samples, maria_ml to review PR implications for onboarding new q configs.

sam_runtime: I will draft a tiny repro that toggles packed-kv; need to instrument where offsets are computed. If bisect shows #741, will prepare revert + patch.
tara_research: I'll add a smoke prompt set and an assertion that checks for repeated-token runs (>3 consecutive same token or >2 repeated entity substrings) and fail CI for quant models.

maria_ml: note for release notes: mention q4p longctx caveat until patched. also coordinate with support in case customers hit similar.

kevin_eval: reproduction notes + five failing prompt ids uploaded to: https://internal.redwood/evals/19456788/failures.json
deploy-bot: issue created: INF-3148 "q4p packed-kv duplication on longctx -> hallucination spike" assigned to sam_runtime. severity: P2.

maria_ml: thanks all. short-term mitigation: pin new onboardings to no-packed-kv until patch. I'll notify onboarding docs owner.

kevin_eval: will keep thread updated with bisect result. thanks.
